post.description:
Create a hosted login session and get a URL to send the user to.

Use this when you don't want to run an OIDC client — typically a native app that opens `loginUrl` in an in-app browser.

**Flow:**
1. `POST` here to get `loginUrl`
2. Open it; the user authenticates with BankID on sajn's hosted page
3. We redirect to your `redirectUri` with `?sessionId=…` (and `?state=…` if you sent one)
4. `GET /api/v1/login/sessions/{id}` **from your server** to read the result

**The redirect is only a handle.** Never trust it as proof of authentication — anyone can craft that URL. The server-side `GET` is the authoritative read, because it is authenticated as your organization.

`redirectUri` must be registered on the client. Custom schemes (`myapp://auth`) are supported so the in-app browser can dismiss straight back into your app.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

clientId.description: The sajn Login client to authenticate against.

redirectUri.description: Where to send the user when authentication finishes. Must be registered on the client.

state.description: Opaque value echoed back on the redirect and in the session result.

loginUrl.description: Open this in a browser or in-app browser to authenticate the user.

get.description:
Authoritative read of a login session. Call this from your server after the redirect.

`claims` and `sub` are populated only once `status` is `COMPLETED`, and contain exactly the fields your client is approved for — the same projection the OIDC `id_token` uses.

`sub` is stable per person **per organization**: the same individual logging into any of your clients always yields the same `sub`, and it can never be correlated with their identifier at another sajn customer.
get.summary: Read the result of a sajn Login session

get.description: List forms in the authenticated workspace, ordered by updatedAt then ID ascending. Use updatedAfter for incremental sync and nextCursor to continue with the same filters.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Only forms updated at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: If `true`, returns only published forms. If `false`, returns only unpublished forms.

post.description: Create a blank form or an independent copy of templateId. The source template is unchanged. Copying a template additionally requires templates:read. Configure settings, document fields and parties through the form endpoints, then publish. Use Idempotency-Key when retrying creation.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

templateId.description: The ID of the template the form owns. Its documents are created from it.

senderUserId.description: The ID of the member every document from the form is created and sent as.

respondentPartyId.description: The ID of the template party the respondent becomes. Null on a draft without one.

enabled.description: True if the form is published.

closedReason.description: Why a published form stopped accepting submissions. Null while it's open.

hasPassword.description: True if the link requires a password.

title.description: Heading of the public form page.

thankYouMessage.description: Message shown after the respondent submits.

redirectUrl.description: URL the respondent goes to after submitting.

documentExpiresInDays.description: Days each document created from a submission stays signable.

expiresAt.description: When the form closes to new submissions, as an ISO 8601 date-time. Null keeps it open.

maxSubmissions.description: Most submissions the form accepts. Null means no limit.

submissionCount.description: Active starts plus submitted responses, counted against `maxSubmissions`.

createdAt.description: When the form was created.

updatedAt.description: When the form was last updated.

slots.description: The keyed FORM subfields of the form's document that a `field` question can fill.

publishIssues.description: What stops the form from publishing (`blocker`) or deserves a look (`warning`). Empty when the form is ready.

patch.description: Omitted settings stay unchanged; nullable values can be cleared explicitly. Questions replace the complete ordered question list. Saving never publishes or changes the sender. Requires forms:write and documents:write, including for drafts. An edit introducing a blocker closes a published form until it is fixed and republished.

post.description: Validate readiness and publish or reopen the form. The authenticated user becomes the sender of future documents and must be allowed to create and send documents without approval. Plan, signing methods, expiry and capacity are checked. Requires forms:write and documents:write.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The form ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

templateId.description: The ID of the template the form owns. Its documents are created from it.

senderUserId.description: The ID of the member every document from the form is created and sent as.

respondentPartyId.description: The ID of the template party the respondent becomes. Null on a draft without one.

enabled.description: True if the form is published.

closedReason.description: Why a published form stopped accepting submissions. Null while it's open.

hasPassword.description: True if the link requires a password.

title.description: Heading of the public form page.

thankYouMessage.description: Message shown after the respondent submits.

redirectUrl.description: URL the respondent goes to after submitting.

documentExpiresInDays.description: Days each document created from a submission stays signable.

expiresAt.description: When the form closes to new submissions, as an ISO 8601 date-time. Null keeps it open.

maxSubmissions.description: Most submissions the form accepts. Null means no limit.

submissionCount.description: Active starts plus submitted responses, counted against `maxSubmissions`.

createdAt.description: When the form was created.

updatedAt.description: When the form was last updated.

slots.description: The keyed FORM subfields of the form's document that a `field` question can fill.

publishIssues.description: What stops the form from publishing (`blocker`) or deserves a look (`warning`). Empty when the form is ready.

put.description: Choose an existing SIGNER from this form's document by its party ID. The visitor fills this party's slot. Invalid edits close a published form. Requires forms:write and documents:write, including for drafts.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The form ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

templateId.description: The ID of the template the form owns. Its documents are created from it.

senderUserId.description: The ID of the member every document from the form is created and sent as.

respondentPartyId.description: The ID of the template party the respondent becomes. Null on a draft without one.

enabled.description: True if the form is published.

closedReason.description: Why a published form stopped accepting submissions. Null while it's open.

hasPassword.description: True if the link requires a password.

title.description: Heading of the public form page.

thankYouMessage.description: Message shown after the respondent submits.

redirectUrl.description: URL the respondent goes to after submitting.

documentExpiresInDays.description: Days each document created from a submission stays signable.

expiresAt.description: When the form closes to new submissions, as an ISO 8601 date-time. Null keeps it open.

maxSubmissions.description: Most submissions the form accepts. Null means no limit.

submissionCount.description: Active starts plus submitted responses, counted against `maxSubmissions`.

createdAt.description: When the form was created.

updatedAt.description: When the form was last updated.

slots.description: The keyed FORM subfields of the form's document that a `field` question can fill.

publishIssues.description: What stops the form from publishing (`blocker`) or deserves a look (`warning`). Empty when the form is ready.

put.description: Replace the complete party list. Include IDs to retain parties; omit IDs to create them. Omitted properties on retained parties, including their PIN, stay unchanged. Null clears nullable properties. Missing parties are deleted. If the respondent is removed, select another SIGNER before publishing. Existing submissions are unchanged. Requires forms:write and documents:write, including for drafts.

get.description: Read answers and respondent contact details, ordered by updatedAt then ID ascending. Use updatedAfter to sync status changes, submittedAfter to filter submitted responses, and nextCursor with unchanged filters. documentId links to the ordinary document API, which separately enforces document access. Poll this endpoint with updatedAfter to synchronize responses.

parameters.description: The form ID.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Returns only submissions with this status.

parameters.name: submittedAfter
parameters.description: Only submissions submitted at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Only submissions updated at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

answers.description: The respondent's answers, keyed by field key. Null until the respondent submits.

documentId.description: The ID of the document created from the submission. Null until one exists.

startedAt.description: When the respondent opened the form, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

submittedAt.description: When the respondent submitted, as an ISO 8601 date-time. Null until then.

updatedAt.description: When the form submission was last updated.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

hasNextPage.description: True if another page follows; false on the last page.

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of all documents in your workspace.

Documents can be filtered and sorted. The response includes basic document information and metadata. Use the 'getDocument' endpoint to retrieve full document details including parties and fields.

**Page-based pagination:** `page` and `perPage` (max 100). The response carries `total` and `totalPages`.

**Cursor pagination (recommended for sync):** pass `nextCursor` from the previous response as `cursor`. Cursor pages are stable while documents change underneath, which page numbers are not. Requires `orderBy` createdAt or updatedAt (the default). `page` is ignored when `cursor` is set.

**Incremental sync:** filter with `updatedAfter` set to the newest `updatedAt` you have stored, order by updatedAt ascending, and walk the cursor until `hasNextPage` is false.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Default: 1.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 100. Default: 10.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by document status. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: tagId
parameters.description: Filter by one or more tag IDs. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Filter by folder. Pass an empty string to include only top-level documents.

parameters.name: externalId
parameters.description: Returns only the document whose `externalId` equals this value exactly. For partial matches, use `query`.

parameters.name: responsibleUserId
parameters.description: Filter by responsible user IDs. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only documents created at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Only documents created at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Only documents updated at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time. Use this for incremental sync.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Only documents updated at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: completedAfter
parameters.description: Only documents completed at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: completedBefore
parameters.description: Only documents completed at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Keyset pagination cursor: pass the `nextCursor` from the previous response. Replaces `page`. Only valid with `orderBy` createdAt or updatedAt.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-text search across name, externalId, signer name, and signer email

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: If `true`, returns only archived documents. If `false`, returns only documents that aren't archived. Default: `false`.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Field to sort by

parameters.name: orderDirection
parameters.description: Sort direction

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

200.description: Paginated list of documents

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for this document

expiresAt.description: Date and time when the document expires

status.description: Document status: DRAFT, SENDING, PENDING, COMPLETED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED, or IMPORTED

documentMeta.description: Document metadata including subject, message, signing order, etc.

subject.description: Email subject line when sending document

message.description: Custom message included in signing invitation

signingOrder.description: Signing order: PARALLEL (all signers can sign simultaneously) or SEQUENTIAL (signers must sign in order)

forceReadFullDocument.description: Whether signers must read the entire document before signing

showChatToSigners.description: Whether to show document chat to signers

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred language for the signing interface: sv (Swedish), en (English), no (Norwegian), da (Danish), or fi (Finnish)

value.description: Monetary value of the document (for contracts)

redirectUrl.description: URL to redirect signers to after signing is complete. New values must be http(s); legacy values are returned as stored.

redirectEnabled.description: Whether redirect after signing is enabled

internalRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive a copy of the sealed PDF once the document is completed

signableAfterExpired.description: Whether the document remains signable after its expiration date

sendPlainTextEmailOnly.description: Send plain text email invitations only (no HTML). null inherits the workspace default.

allowDelegation.description: Whether signers may delegate signing to another person

accessVerification.description: Document-wide verification required to open the document

aiChatEnabled.description: Whether the signer-facing AI chat is enabled. null inherits the workspace default.

nationalIdDisplayMode.description: How national identity numbers are displayed to signers: FULL, PARTIAL, or NONE. null inherits the workspace default.

sameDeviceSigning.description: Whether all parties sign in sequence on one device

documentCategoryId.description: Document category (Dokumenttyp) scoping which custom fields apply. See GET /api/v1/document-categories.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the document was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the document was last updated

completedAt.description: Date and time when all signers completed signing

totalPages.description: Total number of pages available (page-based pagination)

hasNextPage.description: Whether more documents exist after this page

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null on the last page. Pass it as `cursor` on the next request.

post.description:
Create a new document in DRAFT status. You can optionally include parties, metadata, and responsible user during creation.

**Document Types:**
- `SIGNABLE` (default) - Standard signing document
- `ACCEPTABLE` - Document that requires acceptance rather than signature
- `ARCHIVE_IMPORTED` - Imported from external archive

**Template Support:** Use `templateId` to create a document from a template. The template's fields and parties are copied. If you also send `parties`, they replace the template's parties, and signature and initials boxes placed on the PDF for the template's parties are removed.

**CRM Link:** Use `integrationLink` to link the document to a CRM record (currently HubSpot deals). When the workspace has a field mapping configured for the integration, mapped custom fields and product-table rows are prefilled from the record, and signing status is written back to it. Explicit `customFields` in the request take precedence over prefilled values.

**Responsible User:** Use `responsibleUserId` to assign a specific team member as responsible for the document. Defaults to the creating user if not specified.

**Adding Parties:** Two approaches are supported:
1. **Contact-based** (recommended): Provide `contactId` to reference existing contacts - automatically inherits all contact details
2. **Manual**: Provide `name` and `email` to manually specify party details

**Party Examples:**
```json
{
  "parties": [
    {
      "contactId": "contact-123",
      "role": "SIGNER",
      "signingOrder": 1,
      "deliveryMethod": "EMAIL",
      "requiredSignature": "SE_BANKID"
    },
    {
      "name": "John Doe",
      "email": "john@example.com",
      "role": "SIGNER",
      "signingOrder": 2,
      "deliveryMethod": "SMS",
      "requiredSignature": "DRAWING"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Per-Party Settings:**
- `deliveryMethod` - How to notify: `EMAIL` (default), `SMS`, or `NONE`
- `requiredSignature` - Signature type: `DRAWING`, `SE_BANKID` (Swedish BankID), `CLICK_TO_SIGN`, `MANUAL`, or a national eID scheme. eID schemes are switched on market by market — call `GET /api/v1/helpers/signature-methods` for the set your account can actually use rather than hard-coding a list
- `twoStepVerification` - identity gate passed BEFORE the document opens: `NONE` (default), `PIN_BEFORE_SIGNING`, `SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING`, `EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING`, or an eID gate such as `SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING` — call `GET /api/v1/helpers/two-step-verifications` for the live list

**Complete Workflow with Templates:**

1. **Create template** (manually in dashboard) with FORM fields containing keys (e.g., "name", "phone", "email")
2. **Create document from template** (this endpoint) - include parties with their `deliveryMethod` and `requiredSignature` settings
3. **Fill in values** by key, all in one request: `PATCH /api/v1/documents/{docId}/field-values`. To list the keys, call `GET /api/v1/documents/{docId}/field-values`.
4. **Add more parties** if needed: `POST /api/v1/documents/{docId}/parties`
5. **Send for signing**: `POST /api/v1/documents/{docId}/send`

**Note:** Each party can have their own `deliveryMethod` (EMAIL, SMS, NONE) and `requiredSignature` (DRAWING, SE_BANKID, CLICK_TO_SIGN) configured when adding them.

**Example workflow:**
```json
# Step 1: Create document from template with parties
POST /api/v1/documents
{
  "name": "Employment Contract",
  "templateId": "template-id-with-form-fields",
  "parties": [
    {
      "contactId": "contact-456",
      "role": "SIGNER",
      "deliveryMethod": "EMAIL",
      "requiredSignature": "SE_BANKID"
    }
  ]
}

# Step 2: Fill in values by key
PATCH /api/v1/documents/{docId}/field-values
{
  "values": [
    {"key": "name", "value": "Alex Andersson"},
    {"key": "phone", "value": "+46700000000"}
  ]
}

# Step 3: Send for signing
POST /api/v1/documents/{docId}/send
{}
```

**Response:** Returns the created document in the same shape as `GET /api/v1/documents/{id}`, without `fields`. To get a party's signing URL, call `GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/parties/{partyId}`.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for tracking this document

expiresAt.description: Expiration date for the document

type.description: Document type: SIGNABLE (default), ACCEPTABLE, or ARCHIVE_IMPORTED

templateId.description: Template ID to create document from. The template's fields and parties are copied. If you also send `parties`, they replace the template's parties, and signature and initials boxes placed for the template's parties are removed.

responsibleUserId.description: User ID of the person responsible for this document. Must be a member of your organization. Defaults to the creating user.

documentMeta.description: Document metadata including subject, message, signing order, etc.

subject.description: Email subject line when sending document

message.description: Custom message included in signing invitation

signingOrder.description: Signing order: PARALLEL (all signers can sign simultaneously) or SEQUENTIAL (signers must sign in order)

forceReadFullDocument.description: Whether signers must read the entire document before signing

showChatToSigners.description: Whether to show document chat to signers

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred language for the signing interface: sv (Swedish), en (English), no (Norwegian), da (Danish), or fi (Finnish)

value.description: Monetary value of the document (for contracts)

redirectUrl.description: URL to redirect signers to after signing is complete. Must be http(s).

redirectEnabled.description: Whether redirect after signing is enabled

internalRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive a copy of the sealed PDF once the document is completed (max 5). Pass an empty array to clear.

signableAfterExpired.description: Whether the document remains signable after its expiration date

sendPlainTextEmailOnly.description: Send plain text email invitations only (no HTML). null inherits the workspace default.

allowDelegation.description: Whether signers may delegate signing to another person

accessVerification.description: Document-wide verification required to open: NONE (default), SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING, EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING, or SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING

aiChatEnabled.description: Whether the signer-facing AI chat is enabled. null inherits the workspace default.

nationalIdDisplayMode.description: How national identity numbers are displayed to signers: FULL, PARTIAL, or NONE. null inherits the workspace default.

sameDeviceSigning.description: Whether all parties sign in sequence on one device

documentCategoryId.description: Document category (Dokumenttyp) ID. See GET /api/v1/document-categories.

documentStyle.description: Document styling configuration including orientation, padding, background, and layout

paddingEnabled.description: Whether to show padding around document content. When false, content fills entire page edge-to-edge (default: true)

backgroundColor.description: Background color for the document in hex format (e.g., #ffffff for white, #000000 for black). Default: #ffffff

backgroundOpacity.description: Opacity of the background color (0-1). Default: 1

backgroundImageSize.description: Background image sizing: FILL, FIT, or ORIGINAL. Default: FILL

backgroundImageRepeat.description: Background image repeat: REPEAT or NO_REPEAT. Default: NO_REPEAT

backgroundImageOpacity.description: Opacity of the background image (0-1). Default: 1

pageSize.description: Page size: A4 (default), A3, or SLIDE

theme.description: Document theme: body and heading fonts, text, heading and accent colors, density and text size. null resets to the default theme.

parties.description: Array of parties to add to the document during creation. Provide either contactId to reference existing contacts, or name and email to manually specify party details.

contactId.description: ID of existing contact to add as a party

role.description: Party role: SIGNER, ORGANIZER, or REVIEWER.

signingOrder.description: Order for sequential signing (1, 2, 3, etc.). Ignored for parallel signing.

deliveryMethod.description: Per-party delivery method: EMAIL (default), SMS, or NONE (manual link sharing)

requiredSignature.description: Per-party signature type: DRAWING, SE_BANKID, or CLICK_TO_SIGN. Defaults to organization settings.

twoStepVerification.description: Per-party 2FA: NONE (default), SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING, EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING, or SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the party (e.g. SWE, USA, DEU)

get.description:
List the content blocks of a document in position order, with full type-specific metadata.

For `PDF` fields, `fieldMeta.placedFields` holds the boxes placed on the PDF pages (signature and initials marks, signer inputs, fixed text) with their page and coordinates, and `fieldMeta.formFields` holds form fields extracted from the PDF itself. See the field placement guide for the coordinate model.

post.description:
Add a field/section to a document. Can create single field or multiple fields at once.

**Field Types:**
- `TEXT` - Rich text content section (Tiptap editor format)
- `HTML` - Raw HTML content with custom styling (API-only, sanitized for security)
- `FORM` - Form with input fields for signers
- `PDF` - PDF file section
- `PRODUCT_TABLE` - Product/service table with pricing
- `TABLE` - Simple table with custom rows and columns
- `SPACER`, `PAGE_BREAK`, `DURATION` - Layout and duration blocks

**Field Position:** Determines the order fields appear in the document (0-based index).

**Field Metadata:** Each field type has specific metadata requirements. See schema documentation for details.

**Placing fields on a PDF:** a `PDF` field renders an uploaded PDF (`fieldMeta.value` is the storage `key` returned by the files endpoint). Add boxes on its pages with `fieldMeta.placedFields`. Each entry has a unique `id`, `page` (0-based), `rect` (`x`, `y`, `width`, `height` in PDF points, origin at the bottom-left corner of the page), and a `kind`. The server fills `pageWidth`, `pageHeight`, and `pageRotation` from the PDF page when you omit them. If you send `pageWidth` and `pageHeight`, `rect` is measured on a page of that size and scaled to the real page. The box kinds are the following:
- `input` with `inputType` `signature` or `initials` and a `partyId`: a mark the party draws at signing, sealed into the PDF at that position.
- `input` with `inputType` `text`, `date`, `checkbox` or `select` and a `partyId`: a value the party fills in before signing. Set `required` to block signing until it is filled.
- `static` with `content` (HTML): fixed text stamped at that position.

Set `key` on an `input` box to fill it in by that key through `PATCH /api/v1/documents/{id}/field-values`. A key can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores.

Example:
```json
{
  "type": "PDF",
  "position": 0,
  "fieldMeta": {
    "type": "PDF",
    "value": "f/org_123/abc123def/contract.pdf",
    "placedFields": [
      {
        "id": "sig-1",
        "kind": "input",
        "inputType": "signature",
        "page": 2,
        "rect": { "x": 72, "y": 96, "width": 200, "height": 48 },
        "pageWidth": 595.28,
        "pageHeight": 841.89,
        "partyId": "PARTY_ID",
        "required": true
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

The request fails with an HTTP `400 Bad Request` status code, and writes nothing, when a box has a `page` the PDF doesn't have, doesn't fit on its page, names a `partyId` that isn't a party on the document, or is a `signature` or `initials` box without a party with the `SIGNER` role. The `issues` array in the response lists every problem with its path, such as `fieldMeta.placedFields.2.rect`.

The response lists the created fields in request order, each in the same shape as `GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/fields/{fieldId}`. To add, move, or remove single boxes later, use `PATCH /api/v1/documents/{id}/fields/{fieldId}/placed-fields`.

**HTML Field Security:** HTML fields accept raw HTML but are automatically sanitized server-side to allow only safe formatting tags (p, div, span, headings, lists, tables, images) and basic CSS styling. Links, script tags, and dangerous attributes are stripped. Images support HTTP/HTTPS URLs and data URIs for inline images.

patch.description:
Update several FORM subfield values by key in a single atomic request. Only DRAFT documents can have fields updated.

Use this instead of looping single-key `PATCH .../fields/key:<key>` calls. Because all FORM subfields share one underlying field row, concurrent single-key requests read-modify-write the same row and overwrite each other (lost updates). This endpoint applies all changes against one read per affected field, so nothing is clobbered.

**Body:**
```json
PATCH /api/v1/documents/{docId}/fields
{
  "updates": [
    { "key": "name",  "fieldMeta": { "type": "input", "value": "Andreas" } },
    { "key": "phone", "fieldMeta": { "type": "input", "value": "070-1234567" } },
    { "key": "email", "fieldMeta": { "type": "input", "value": "a@example.com" } }
  ]
}
```

Each entry's `fieldMeta` is merged into the existing subfield metadata (preserving label, placeholder, description, etc.), identical to the single-key endpoint. Max 50 updates per request.

**Response:** Returns a per-key result array so partial failures (e.g. an unknown key) are reported individually while valid updates still apply. `success` is `true` only when every update succeeded.

get.description:
Retrieve detailed information about a specific document including all parties, tags, and custom field values.

The response includes:
- Document metadata (subject, message, signing order, etc.)
- All document parties with their status
- Applied tags
- Custom field values
- Product tables with their resolved totals
- Document timestamps (created, updated, completed, archived)

**Content blocks:** The response leaves out `fields` unless you pass `expand=fields`. To poll a document's status, leave it out. To read the content, pass `expand=fields` or call `GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/fields`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Related data to include in the response, comma-separated or repeated. `fields` adds the document's content blocks.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for this document

expiresAt.description: Date and time when the document expires

status.description: Document status: DRAFT, SENDING, PENDING, COMPLETED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED, or IMPORTED

documentMeta.description: Document metadata including subject, message, signing order, etc.

subject.description: Email subject line when sending document

message.description: Custom message included in signing invitation

signingOrder.description: Signing order: PARALLEL (all signers can sign simultaneously) or SEQUENTIAL (signers must sign in order)

forceReadFullDocument.description: Whether signers must read the entire document before signing

showChatToSigners.description: Whether to show document chat to signers

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred language for the signing interface: sv (Swedish), en (English), no (Norwegian), da (Danish), or fi (Finnish)

value.description: Monetary value of the document (for contracts)

redirectUrl.description: URL to redirect signers to after signing is complete. New values must be http(s); legacy values are returned as stored.

redirectEnabled.description: Whether redirect after signing is enabled

internalRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive a copy of the sealed PDF once the document is completed

signableAfterExpired.description: Whether the document remains signable after its expiration date

sendPlainTextEmailOnly.description: Send plain text email invitations only (no HTML). null inherits the workspace default.

allowDelegation.description: Whether signers may delegate signing to another person

accessVerification.description: Document-wide verification required to open the document

aiChatEnabled.description: Whether the signer-facing AI chat is enabled. null inherits the workspace default.

nationalIdDisplayMode.description: How national identity numbers are displayed to signers: FULL, PARTIAL, or NONE. null inherits the workspace default.

sameDeviceSigning.description: Whether all parties sign in sequence on one device

documentCategoryId.description: Document category (Dokumenttyp) scoping which custom fields apply. See GET /api/v1/document-categories.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the document was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the document was last updated

completedAt.description: Date and time when all signers completed signing

parties.description: Array of document parties (signers and other participants).

documentId.description: Document ID this signer belongs to

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for this signer

contactId.description: ID of the contact this party was created from, if any

nationalId.description: National identity number supplied by the sender when creating the document. Optional — BankID works without it, falling back to a name check. This is input and is never overwritten with what the eID verified: read the verified identity from GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/signatures.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the signer (e.g. SWE)

role.description: Signer role: SIGNER, ORGANIZER, or REVIEWER

signingOrder.description: Order for sequential signing (null for parallel)

signedAt.description: Date and time when the signer signed (null if not signed)

readStatus.description: Read status: NOT_OPENED, OPENED, or READ

signingStatus.description: Signing status: NOT_SIGNED, SIGNED, or REJECTED

deliveryMethod.description: How documents are sent to this signer: EMAIL, SMS, or NONE

requiredSignature.description: Signature type required: DRAWING, SE_BANKID, CLICK_TO_SIGN, etc.

twoStepVerification.description: Two-step verification: NONE, SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING, EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING, or SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING

sendStatus.description: Send status: NOT_SENT, SENT, DELIVERED, BOUNCED, or FAILED

identityVerified.description: True when an eID verified this signer — either by signing with one or by passing an eID verification gate.

identityMismatch.description: True when an eID completed, the identity did not match the intended signer, and the signature was still recorded — read GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/signatures to see what differed. Stays false when the workspace requires a national ID match to sign and the attempt was refused, because no signature exists; those attempts appear only in the document audit trail.

fields.description: Content blocks in position order, present only when you pass `expand=fields`. See the field endpoints for the per-type shapes.

position.description: 0-based order of the field among the document's content blocks

fieldMeta.description: Type-specific content. For PDF fields this includes `placedFields` (boxes placed on the PDF pages) and `formFields` (form fields extracted from the PDF).

createdAt.description: Date and time when the field was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the field was last updated

fieldMeta.content: Anställningen gäller tills vidare från och med den 1 november 2026, med sex månaders provanställning.

currency.description: ISO 4217; null on tables authored before currencies

selectionPartyId.description: The party who makes the selection

price.description: Unit price, in the basis the table was priced in (excl. moms unless the table prices include it)

moms.description: Moms rate in percent, falling back to the table default

discount.description: Row discount, off the row amount

optional.description: The recipient may choose whether to include this row

selected.description: Whether the row counts towards the totals. Declined rows are still listed, with false.

quantity.description: Final quantity, including a recipient-set one

lineTotal.description: price × quantity − discount, in the basis the price was entered in

rows.description: Every row, selected or not, in table order

totals.description: Computed from the selected rows only

productTables.description: Every product table on the document, resolved: each row carries the recipient's final `selected` state and `quantity`, and the totals count the selected rows only. Empty when the document has no product table.

documentMeta.subject: Ditt anställningsavtal från Exempelbolaget AB
documentMeta.message: Hej Kai! Här är ditt anställningsavtal. Signera det med BankID senast den 28 oktober.

fieldMeta.content: Anställningen gäller tills vidare från och med den 1 november 2026, med sex månaders provanställning.

patch.description:
Update document properties. A DRAFT document accepts every field. After sending, what you can change depends on the field, and a locked field returns `400` with the reason.

**Updatable Fields:**
- `name` - Document title
- `externalId` - Your external reference ID
- `expiresAt` - Document expiration date
- `responsibleUserId` - User ID of responsible team member (must be in your organization)
- `documentMeta` - Metadata including subject, message, and signing order
- `customFields` - Custom field values

**Per-party settings:** Delivery method and signature type are set per party through the parties endpoints, not at the document level.

**After sending:**
- `name`, `externalId`, `responsibleUserId`, `value` and `documentCategoryId` can always change.
- Reminders, subject, message, redirect, chat, delegation, internal recipients and `signableAfterExpired` can change until the document is completed, cancelled or rejected.
- `expiresAt` moves the deadline (at least 24 hours ahead) and notifies the parties, like `POST /api/v1/documents/{id}/extend-expiration`.
- `accessVerification`, `forceReadFullDocument` and `preferredLanguage` can change until someone has signed.
- `signingOrder`, `nationalIdDisplayMode`, `sameDeviceSigning` and `documentStyle` can't change; withdraw the document first.

delete.description:
Move a document to the trash. It is marked as deleted but not yet removed — restore it, or let the workspace's trash window purge it.

Works for every status, including `COMPLETED`. You are the controller of your data; deciding when a signed agreement goes is your call.

**Note:** Deleted documents are not included in list responses but can still be retrieved by ID.

**To remove a document immediately and irreversibly**, use `POST /api/v1/documents/{id}/purge`.

get.description:
Retrieve the activity/audit log for a specific document. Returns all activity events sorted newest-first.

**Response includes:**
- Event type (e.g., DOCUMENT_CREATED, DOCUMENT_SIGNED, EMAIL_SENT)
- Timestamp of the event
- Event-specific data payload
- Name and email of the person who triggered the event (when available)

**Privacy:** Sensitive fields such as IP address, user agent, and request metadata are not included in the response.

get.description:
The identity each eID actually verified, per signature — as opposed to the signer details the sender entered when creating the document.

**Why this is a separate endpoint:** `party.nationalId` is what the sender supplied. It is never overwritten with what the eID returned, so the two can differ, and this is where you read the verified one.

**One shape for every eID.** Keys are always present and null when a scheme issues nothing, so you never branch on provider to find where the identity lives:
- `identity.nationalId` — the national identity number, masked per the workspace's national ID display setting. **Null for schemes that issue none:** MitID without CPR scope, MitID Erhverv, and iDIN, which may never expose a BSN.
- `identity.serialNumber` — always present. A stable, non-sensitive reference for this person at your organization. Use it to recognise a returning signer without ever handling a national id. Scoped per organization, so the same person yields a different value for a different customer.
- `identity.match` — whether the verified identity matched the intended signer. Computed before masking, so it stays meaningful even when `nationalId` is hidden by policy.

`identity` is null for drawn and click-to-sign signatures: nothing verified an identity.

**Permissions:** requires the `READ_DOCUMENT` workspace permission and the `signatures:read` scope. `documents:read` alone never returns a national identity number.

**Auditing:** every call is recorded on the organization audit log — who read a verified identity and when. The identity values themselves are never logged.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

partyName.description: The name on the party record, as entered by the sender.

identity.description: Null when no eID verified this signature — a drawn or click-to-sign signature.

provider.description: The eID that verified this identity, e.g. SE_BANKID, DK_MITID. Also tells you the format of nationalId.

name.description: Legal name as reported by the eID — not the name the sender typed.

nationalId.description: National identity number the eID returned, masked per the workspace national ID display setting. Null when the scheme issues none: MitID without CPR scope, and iDIN, which may never expose a BSN.

nationalIdSuppressed.description: Set when a national id exists but the workspace policy hides it. Distinguishes "hidden from you" from "the eID never issued one".

serialNumber.description: Stable, non-sensitive reference for this person at this organization. Present for every eID. Use it to recognise a returning signer without handling a national id. Scoped per organization, so it cannot be correlated across customers.

dateOfBirth.description: ISO date, when the scheme reports it.

company.description: Registry-verified organizational identity — MitID Erhverv only.

match.description: Whether the verified identity matched the signer the sender intended. Computed before masking, so it stays meaningful even when nationalId is hidden.

get.description:
Get a download URL for a specific file of a document. The file type is part of the path and is required.

**Path Parameters:**
- `fileType` (ORIGINAL | SIGNED | JOURNAL): Which file to download.
    - `ORIGINAL` — the unsigned source document (available for all statuses).
    - `SIGNED` — the signed/sealed copy (document must be COMPLETED).
    - `JOURNAL` — the signing journal / audit trail (document must be COMPLETED).

**Response:** Returns a pre-signed URL valid for 15 minutes. The URL provides secure access to the document file.

Returns 404 if the requested file does not exist for this document.

post.description:
Send a document to signers for signing.

**Request Body:**
- `customMessage` (optional) - Custom message to include in the signing invitation emails/SMS. Supports newline characters (`\n`) for line breaks. Available template variables (use `{{variableName}}` syntax): `{{firstName}}`, `{{lastName}}`, `{{fullName}}`, `{{recipientFirstName}}`, `{{recipientLastName}}`, `{{recipientFullName}}`, `{{recipientEmail}}`, `{{recipientPhone}}`, `{{recipientCompanyName}}`, `{{recipientCompanyRole}}`, `{{recipientCompanyOrgNumber}}`, `{{recipientRole}}`, `{{senderFirstName}}`, `{{senderLastName}}`, `{{senderFullName}}`, `{{senderEmail}}`, `{{senderCompanyName}}`, `{{documentName}}`, `{{documentId}}`, `{{documentValue}}`, `{{documentCreatedDate}}`, `{{expirationDate}}`, `{{signUrl}}`. Custom fields are available as `{{custom.<field-slug>}}` using the slugified field name (e.g. "Avtalsdatum (demo)" becomes `{{custom.avtalsdatum-demo}}`); secured fields are excluded.
- `approverId` (optional) - User ID of the approver. Required if you lack the SEND_WITHOUT_APPROVAL permission. Use `GET /api/v1/approvers` to list eligible approvers.

**Prerequisites:**
- Document must have at least one signer added via `POST /documents/{id}/parties` or when creating the document
- Each signer's delivery method (`EMAIL`, `SMS`, or `NONE`) and signature type (`DRAWING`, `SE_BANKID`, `CLICK_TO_SIGN`) are configured per-signer when adding them

**Responses:**
- **200** - Document sent directly. Status changes from DRAFT to PENDING.
- **202** - Document submitted for approval. Status changes from DRAFT to PENDING_APPROVAL. The designated approver must approve before the document is sent.
- **403** with `code: "APPROVAL_REQUIRED"` - You lack permission to send directly. Provide an `approverId` to submit for approval.

**What happens when you send:**
1. Document status changes from `DRAFT` to `PENDING`
2. Signing invitations are sent to each signer based on their individual `deliveryMethod` setting
3. Signers with `deliveryMethod: NONE` won't receive notifications - use their signing URLs directly

Custom fields are available as {{custom.<field-slug>}} using the slugified field name (e.g. "Avtalsdatum (demo)" becomes {{custom.avtalsdatum-demo}}); secured fields are excluded.

post.description:
Withdraw (cancel) a document that has been sent out for signing. The document is returned to `DRAFT` status and signers are notified.

**Status Requirements:**
- Document must be in `PENDING` or `SENDING` status. Use `DELETE /api/v1/documents/{id}` for documents in `DRAFT`, and the approval cancel endpoint for `PENDING_APPROVAL`.

**Permissions:**
- Requires the `EDIT_DOCUMENT` workspace permission.

**Request Body:**
- `reason` (optional) - Free-text reason. Included in withdrawal emails to signers and stored on the audit log.

**What happens when you withdraw:**
1. Document status is set back to `DRAFT`
2. Any existing signatures and signer verifications are removed
3. Each signer's signing/sending/read status is reset
4. Pending signing reminders are cancelled
5. A withdrawal email is sent to every signer that had been notified
6. The `document.withdrawn` webhook is triggered

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

reason.description: Optional reason for withdrawing the document. Included in notification emails to signers and the audit log.

schema.description: Withdraw a sent document. Returns the document to DRAFT status, removes any signatures, and notifies signers via email.

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for this document

expiresAt.description: Date and time when the document expires

status.description: Document status: DRAFT, SENDING, PENDING, COMPLETED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED, or IMPORTED

documentMeta.description: Document metadata including subject, message, signing order, etc.

subject.description: Email subject line when sending document

message.description: Custom message included in signing invitation

signingOrder.description: Signing order: PARALLEL (all signers can sign simultaneously) or SEQUENTIAL (signers must sign in order)

forceReadFullDocument.description: Whether signers must read the entire document before signing

showChatToSigners.description: Whether to show document chat to signers

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred language for the signing interface: sv (Swedish), en (English), no (Norwegian), da (Danish), or fi (Finnish)

value.description: Monetary value of the document (for contracts)

redirectUrl.description: URL to redirect signers to after signing is complete. New values must be http(s); legacy values are returned as stored.

redirectEnabled.description: Whether redirect after signing is enabled

internalRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive a copy of the sealed PDF once the document is completed

signableAfterExpired.description: Whether the document remains signable after its expiration date

sendPlainTextEmailOnly.description: Send plain text email invitations only (no HTML). null inherits the workspace default.

allowDelegation.description: Whether signers may delegate signing to another person

accessVerification.description: Document-wide verification required to open the document

aiChatEnabled.description: Whether the signer-facing AI chat is enabled. null inherits the workspace default.

nationalIdDisplayMode.description: How national identity numbers are displayed to signers: FULL, PARTIAL, or NONE. null inherits the workspace default.

sameDeviceSigning.description: Whether all parties sign in sequence on one device

documentCategoryId.description: Document category (Dokumenttyp) scoping which custom fields apply. See GET /api/v1/document-categories.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the document was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the document was last updated

completedAt.description: Date and time when all signers completed signing

post.description:
Change the expiration date of a document that has already been sent for signing. The new date can be earlier or later than the current one.

**Status Requirements:**
- Document must be in `PENDING` or `EXPIRED` status. An `EXPIRED` document returns to `PENDING`. For `DRAFT` documents, set `expiresAt` via `PATCH /api/v1/documents/{id}` instead.

**Permissions:**
- Requires the `EDIT_DOCUMENT` workspace permission.

**Request Body:**
- `expiresAt` (required) - The new expiration date/time (ISO 8601). Must be at least 24 hours in the future.

**What happens:**
1. The document's `expiresAt` is updated.
2. An audit log entry is recorded.
3. Every recipient that is still notifiable (has an email, notifications enabled, delivery method other than `NONE`, and has not rejected) is emailed that the signing deadline has moved.

post.description:
Irreversibly delete a document: database rows, uploaded files, the sealed PDF, the signing certificate and the audit trail. There is no undo and no support path to recover it.

**Requirements:**
- The document must already be in the trash. Call `DELETE /api/v1/documents/{id}` first.
- Requires the `PERMANENTLY_DELETE_DOCUMENT` workspace permission, which is not part of the default document-permission set.
- Requires the `documents:delete` scope.

**Completed documents:** allowed, and the verify link printed into the sealed PDF keeps working. It resolves to a record holding the document ID, the sealed PDF's SHA-256 and the deletion date — and no personal data. A counterparty holding the PDF can still check their copy against that hash; the PAdES signature in their file also validates on its own, without sajn.

**Backups:** the document is gone from the live database immediately. Encrypted database backups roll off within 7 days.

post.description:
Add a party (signer/participant) to a document. The party must reference an existing contact.

**Party Roles:**
- `SIGNER` - Must sign the document
- `ORGANIZER` - Document organizer (no signature required)
- `REVIEWER` - Reviews document (no signature required)

**Per-Party Settings:**
- `deliveryMethod` - How to notify: `EMAIL` (default), `SMS`, or `NONE` (use signing URL directly)
- `requiredSignature` - Signature type: `DRAWING`, `SE_BANKID` (Swedish BankID), `CLICK_TO_SIGN`, `MANUAL`, or a national eID scheme. eID schemes are switched on market by market — call `GET /api/v1/helpers/signature-methods` for the set your account can actually use rather than hard-coding a list
- `twoStepVerification` - identity gate passed BEFORE the document opens: `NONE` (default), `PIN_BEFORE_SIGNING`, `SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING`, `EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING`, or an eID gate such as `SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING` — call `GET /api/v1/helpers/two-step-verifications` for the live list

**Signing Order:** For SEQUENTIAL signing, specify the order (1, 2, 3...). For PARALLEL signing, order is ignored.

**Response:** Returns the created party. Use GET /documents/:id/parties/:partyId to retrieve the signing URL.

parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

contactId.description: ID of the contact to add as a signer

role.description: Party role: SIGNER, ORGANIZER, or REVIEWER.

signingOrder.description: Signing order for sequential signing (ignored for parallel)

deliveryMethod.description: How to send to this signer: EMAIL (default), SMS, or NONE

requiredSignature.description: Signature type required: DRAWING (default), SE_BANKID, or CLICK_TO_SIGN

twoStepVerification.description: Two-step verification: NONE (default), SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING, EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING, or SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING

documentId.description: Document ID this signer belongs to

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for this signer

contactId.description: ID of the contact this party was created from, if any

nationalId.description: National identity number supplied by the sender when creating the document. Optional — BankID works without it, falling back to a name check. This is input and is never overwritten with what the eID verified: read the verified identity from GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/signatures.

signingStatus.description: Signing status: NOT_SIGNED, SIGNED, or REJECTED

get.description:
Retrieve all parties for a document WITHOUT signing URLs.

This endpoint returns party information for display purposes. Signing URLs are not included for security reasons.

To get a party's signing URL (which creates an audit log entry), use the GET /documents/:id/parties/:partyId endpoint.

patch.description:
Update party information. Most fields can only be updated before the document is sent.

**Updatable Fields:**
- `name` - Party's full name
- `email` - Party's email address
- `phone` - Party's phone number
- `companyName` - Company name
- `companyRole` - Role within company
- `companyOrgNumber` - Company organization number
- `companyId` - Link to existing company
- `nationalId` - National identity number, such as a Swedish personnummer, matched against the eID at signing
- `role` - Party role (SIGNER, ORGANIZER, REVIEWER)
- `signingOrder` - Order for sequential signing
- `deliveryMethod` - How to notify: `EMAIL`, `SMS`, or `NONE`
- `requiredSignature` - Signature type: `DRAWING`, `SE_BANKID` (Swedish BankID), `CLICK_TO_SIGN`, `MANUAL`, or a national eID scheme. eID schemes are switched on market by market — call `GET /api/v1/helpers/signature-methods` for the set your account can actually use rather than hard-coding a list
- `twoStepVerification` - identity gate passed BEFORE the document opens: `NONE`, `PIN_BEFORE_SIGNING`, `SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING`, `EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING`, or an eID gate such as `SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING` — call `GET /api/v1/helpers/two-step-verifications` for the live list

**Restrictions:** Cannot update after party has signed the document.

parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

deliveryMethod.description: How to send to this signer: EMAIL, SMS, or NONE

requiredSignature.description: Signature type required: DRAWING, SE_BANKID, or CLICK_TO_SIGN

twoStepVerification.description: Two-step verification: NONE, SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING, EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING, or SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING

documentId.description: Document ID this signer belongs to

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for this signer

contactId.description: ID of the contact this party was created from, if any

nationalId.description: National identity number supplied by the sender when creating the document. Optional — BankID works without it, falling back to a name check. This is input and is never overwritten with what the eID verified: read the verified identity from GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/signatures.

role.description: Signer role: SIGNER, ORGANIZER, or REVIEWER

signingOrder.description: Order for sequential signing (null for parallel)

signedAt.description: Date and time when the signer signed (null if not signed)

readStatus.description: Read status: NOT_OPENED, OPENED, or READ

signingStatus.description: Signing status: NOT_SIGNED, SIGNED, or REJECTED

deliveryMethod.description: How documents are sent to this signer: EMAIL, SMS, or NONE

requiredSignature.description: Signature type required: DRAWING, SE_BANKID, CLICK_TO_SIGN, etc.

twoStepVerification.description: Two-step verification: NONE, SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING, EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING, or SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING

sendStatus.description: Send status: NOT_SENT, SENT, DELIVERED, BOUNCED, or FAILED

identityVerified.description: True when an eID verified this signer — either by signing with one or by passing an eID verification gate.

identityMismatch.description: True when an eID completed, the identity did not match the intended signer, and the signature was still recorded — read GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/signatures to see what differed. Stays false when the workspace requires a national ID match to sign and the attempt was refused, because no signature exists; those attempts appear only in the document audit trail.

delete.description:
Remove a party from a document. This operation is only allowed for DRAFT documents.

**Note:** Once a document is sent, parties cannot be removed. You must cancel the document first.

get.description:
Retrieve a specific party including their signing URL.

**Security Note:** This endpoint creates an audit log entry each time a signing URL is accessed. Use this endpoint when you need the signing URL to share with the party.

**Response includes:**
- Party details (name, email, phone, company info)
- Signing status (NOT_SIGNED, SIGNED, REJECTED)
- Read status (NOT_OPENED, OPENED, READ)
- Complete signing URL with token

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of all contacts in your organization.

Contacts are individuals that can be added as signers to documents. Each contact can optionally be associated with a company.

**Pagination:** Use `page` and `perPage`, or pass `nextCursor` from the previous response as `cursor`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Default: 1.

post.description:
Create a new contact in your organization.

**Required Fields:**
- `firstName` - Contact's first name

**Optional Fields:**
- `lastName` - Contact's last name (omit or send an empty string for single-name contacts)
- `email` - Email address
- `phone` - Phone number (for SMS notifications)
- `nationalId` - National identity number, such as a Swedish personnummer, for eID verification
- `externalId` - Your external reference ID for tracking
- `companyId` - Associate with existing company
- `companyRole` - Role within the company

get.description:
Search for contacts by email, phone number, or external ID.

**Query Parameters (at least one required):**
- `email` - Search by exact email address match
- `phone` - Search by exact phone number match
- `externalId` - Search by exact external ID match

**Response:** Returns an array of matching contacts. Empty array if no matches found.

**Note:** All searches are exact matches and scoped to your organization.

patch.description:

**Note:** Updating a contact does not affect existing document signers. Changes only apply to new documents.

parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

companyId.description: ID of company to associate with. Omit to keep the current company, or pass null to unlink it.

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of the companies in your workspace, sorted by name.

Companies can be associated with contacts to track organizational relationships.

**Pagination:** Use `page` and `perPage`, or pass `nextCursor` from the previous response as `cursor`.
**Search:** Use `query` to match part of the company name or organization number.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Default: 1.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 100. Default: 10.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response. Replaces `page`; keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-text search across company name and organization number

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

total.description: Total number of companies matching the filters

hasNextPage.description: True if another page follows; false on the last page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

get.description:
Look up a company in the external company registry by organization number and retrieve detailed information including signatories.

**Query Parameters:**
- `orgNr` (required) - Organization number to search for

**Response includes:**
- Basic company info (name, status, org number)
- Contact information (phone, address)
- Legal information (company form, domicile, registration dates)
- Tax information (VAT registration, verified against the EU VIES registry; `employer` and `fTax` are not currently populated)
- Business info (SNI codes, activity description, company signature)
- Responsible persons (executives, board members, auditors, owners)
- Location coordinates

**Rate Limit:** This endpoint is rate limited to 2 requests per minute.

**Note:** This searches an external registry, not your local workspace companies. Results are cached for 3 days.

patch.description:
Changes individual boxes on a PDF field without sending the whole field. Only DRAFT documents can be changed.

Each box in `upsert` has the same shape as an entry in `fieldMeta.placedFields` on `POST /api/v1/documents/{id}/fields`, and is checked the same way. A box whose `id` already exists on the field replaces that box and keeps its stacking order. A box with a new `id` is added on top. `remove` lists the ids of boxes to delete. Boxes you don't mention stay as they are.

The change is atomic: if any box is invalid, nothing is written and the response lists every problem in `issues`. If another edit changes the field while the request runs, the request fails with an HTTP `400 Bad Request` status code and code `INVALID_STATE`; send it again.

**Example - move one box and remove another:**
```json
PATCH /api/v1/documents/{docId}/fields/{fieldId}/placed-fields
{
  "upsert": [
    {
      "id": "sig-1",
      "kind": "input",
      "inputType": "signature",
      "page": 2,
      "rect": { "x": 72, "y": 120, "width": 200, "height": 48 },
      "partyId": "PARTY_ID"
    }
  ],
  "remove": ["initials-3"]
}
```

get.description:
Lists every value that the sender or a party can fill in on a document, addressed by one `key` each. The list covers FORM subfields, form fields that are part of an uploaded PDF (AcroForm fields), and input boxes placed on a PDF.

To fill in values, send the keys to `PATCH /api/v1/documents/{id}/field-values`.
get.summary: List the fillable values on a document

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: onlyEmpty
parameters.description: If `true`, returns only the values that are empty.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

key.description: The key you send to fill in this value. For a FORM subfield or a placed box, this is the key set in the editor, or the element ID when no key is set. For an AcroForm field, this is the field name in the PDF.

kind.description: Where the value lives: a FORM subfield, a form field that is part of the uploaded PDF, or a box placed on the PDF.

fieldId.description: The ID of the document field that holds this value. For an AcroForm field that spans several page fields, the first of them.

type.description: The input type, such as `INPUT`, `NUMBER`, `DATEPICKER`, `SELECT`, `CHECKBOX`, `text`, `date`, or `checkbox`.

options.description: The allowed values. A value outside this list is rejected.

value.description: The current value, or `null` if the value is empty. A FORM `CHECKBOX` holds a list of the selected options, and a PDF checkbox holds a boolean.

patch.description:
Fills in values by key, in one atomic request. The same request shape works for FORM subfields, AcroForm fields, and boxes placed on a PDF. Only documents with the status DRAFT or IMPORTED can be filled in.

Keys must match exactly. To find the keys, call `GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/field-values`. Set a key in the editor on a FORM subfield or a placed box, or send `key` when you create a placed box through the API, so that the key stays the same for every document created from a template.

The following example fills in a FORM subfield, a placed text box, and a PDF checkbox:

```json
{
  "values": [
    { "key": "customer-name", "value": "Example AB" },
    { "key": "org-number", "value": "556000-0000" },
    { "key": "accept-terms", "value": true }
  ]
}
```

A value fails, and the other values are still written, when its key doesn't exist, when two fields share the key, when a party fills in the value at signing, or when the value doesn't match the type or the allowed options. `results` lists the outcome for each key.

If another edit changes one of the fields while the request runs, nothing is written and the request fails with an HTTP `400 Bad Request` status code. Send the request again.

- `color` - Hex color code (e.g., #FF5733)

get.description:
List a document's links to other documents, in both directions.

**Link types:** AMENDS, REPLACES, RENEWS, RELATES_TO — the from-document acts on the to-document.

**Direction:** FROM means this document is the acting end of the link; TO means another document links to it.

Links whose other end you don't have access to are omitted. A trashed target is returned with `target: null`.

parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

linkType.description: How the documents relate: the from-document AMENDS/REPLACES/RENEWS/RELATES_TO the to-document

direction.description: Which end of the link this document is — FROM means this document is the acting/newer one

origin.description: How the link was created: 'manual', 'duplicate' or 'renewal'

createdAt.description: When the link was created

target.description: The other end of the link; null when that document has been moved to trash

status.description: The other document's status

post.description:
Create a link from this document to another document in the same organization.

**Required Fields:**
- `toDocumentId` - The document to link to
- `linkType` - AMENDS, REPLACES, RENEWS or RELATES_TO (this document acts on the target)

Both documents must be accessible to the acting user. RELATES_TO is symmetric — the same pair can only be related once regardless of direction.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of custom field definitions.

Custom fields allow you to add additional structured data to documents or contacts.

**Query Parameters:**
- `page` - Page number
- `perPage` - Items per page
- `cursor` - The `nextCursor` from the previous response, instead of `page`
- `type` - Filter by type (DOCUMENT or CONTACT)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Default: 1.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 100. Default: 10.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response. Replaces `page`; keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Returns only custom fields of this type.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

inputType.description: Input type: TEXT, NUMBER, DATE, BOOLEAN, SELECT, TEXTAREA, EMAIL, PHONE, URL, or JSON

options.description: Options for SELECT type fields as a JSON-encoded string array, for example `["Small","Large"]`

createdAt.description: Date and time when custom field was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when custom field was last updated

hasNextPage.description: True if another page follows; false on the last page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

post.description:
Create a new custom field definition.

**Required Fields:**
- `name` - Field name
- `type` - DOCUMENT or CONTACT
- `inputType` - Input type (TEXT, NUMBER, DATE, BOOLEAN, SELECT, TEXTAREA, EMAIL, PHONE, URL, JSON)

**Optional Fields:**
- `defaultValue` - Default value for the field
- `required` - Whether field is required (default: false)
- `options` - For SELECT type, the options as a JSON-encoded string array, for example `["Small","Large"]`

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

inputType.description: Input type (required): TEXT, NUMBER, DATE, CHECKBOX, SELECT, TEXTAREA, EMAIL, PHONE, or URL

required.description: Whether this field is required (default: false)

options.description: Options for SELECT type fields as a JSON-encoded string array, for example `["Small","Large"]`

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of all sajn ID identity verifications in your organization.

sajn ID enables secure identity verification using Swedish BankID, either by matching a national identity number or by matching the name.

**Pagination:** Use `page` and `perPage`, or pass `nextCursor` from the previous response as `cursor`.

**Filtering:**
- `status` - Filter by verification status. Comma-separated or repeated.
- `createdAfter` - Only checks created at or after this date or date-time.
- `createdBefore` - Only checks created at or before this date or date-time.

Without a date filter, the list covers every check in the workspace.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Default: 1.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 100. Default: 10.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response. Replaces `page`; keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status. Comma-separated or repeated.

items.description:
sajn ID Status:
- CREATED: Verification created but not sent
- SENT: Verification sent to recipient
- OPENED: Recipient opened verification link
- VERIFIED: Identity successfully verified
- FAILED: Verification failed
- EXPIRED: Verification link expired
- CANCELED: Verification was canceled

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only checks created at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Only checks created at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

post.description:
Create a new identity verification request and immediately send it to the recipient over the chosen channel.

**Required Fields:**
- `fullName` - Full name of person to verify (required)
- `channel` - Delivery channel: EMAIL or SMS (required)
- Channel-specific: `email` (for EMAIL) or `phone` (for SMS)

**Optional Fields:**
- `nationalId` - National identity number, such as a Swedish personnummer. Without it, BankID verifies the name instead.
- `reference` - External reference ID for tracking
- `contactId` - Link to existing contact
- `locale` - Message locale (default: sv-SE)

**Verification Methods:**
- **National ID**: When you provide `nationalId`, BankID verifies the identity and checks that the number matches.
- **Name**: Without `nationalId`, BankID verifies the identity and checks that the name matches.

**Response:** Returns verification details including token and verification URL (only on creation, never exposed later).

**Billing:** Creating a sajn ID verification counts toward your monthly sajn ID quota and is billed accordingly.
post.summary: Create a new sajn ID verification

get.description:
Retrieve detailed information about a specific sajn ID verification including status, audit logs, and verification data.

The response includes:
- Verification status and timestamps
- Contact information (email/phone based on channel)
- Linked contact details (if applicable)
- Complete audit log of all verification events
- Verification data (e.g., BankID response for verified identities)

**Note:** The national identity number is encrypted and never returned in the response.
get.summary: Get a sajn ID verification by ID

get.description:
Retrieve file information and access URL.

**URL Generation:**
- For `PRIVATE` files: Returns a fresh signed URL (valid for 15 minutes)
- For `PUBLIC` files: Returns the permanent CloudFront URL

**Response includes:**
- File metadata (filename, size, MIME type)
- Visibility setting
- Access URL
- Upload information

post.description:
Create a file record and get a presigned URL to upload the bytes **directly to storage**.

**Flow:**
1. Compute the file's SHA-256 hash and base64-encode it.
2. Call this endpoint with the filename, MIME type, size, and checksum. You receive a `fileId` and a presigned `uploadUrl`.
3. `PUT` the raw bytes to `uploadUrl` with headers `Content-Type: <mimeType>` and `x-amz-checksum-sha256: <checksum>`. S3 verifies the checksum on write.
4. (Recommended) Call `POST /api/v1/files/:id/confirm` to verify the upload and flip the record to `CONFIRMED` immediately. Otherwise it is confirmed automatically the first time it is fetched via `GET /api/v1/files/:id`.

**Why:** the bytes go straight to storage, so there is no API-server size limit.

parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

checksum.description: Base64-encoded SHA-256 checksum of the file. S3 enforces it on upload, so a mismatch rejects the bytes.

schema.description: Request a presigned upload URL and create a pending file record

200.description: Presigned upload details

fileId.description: The created file record id. Status is PENDING until the upload is confirmed on first access.

key.description: The S3 object key the file will be stored under

uploadUrl.description: Presigned PUT URL (valid 15 minutes). Upload the bytes here with headers Content-Type: <mimeType> and x-amz-checksum-sha256: <checksum>.
