get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of files in your organization.

**Pagination:** Use `page` and `perPage`, or pass `nextCursor` from the previous response as `cursor`.

**Filtering:** Optionally filter by visibility (PRIVATE or PUBLIC).

**Response:**
- Files are sorted by creation date (newest first)
- Use the 'getFile' endpoint to retrieve file access URLs

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Default: 1.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 100. Default: 10.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response. Replaces `page`; keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: Filter by visibility

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

200.description: Paginated list of files

createdAt.description: Date and time when file was uploaded

updatedAt.description: Date and time when file was last updated

items.description: File information without access URL

hasNextPage.description: True if another page follows; false on the last page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

post.description:
Confirm a previously-created file after its bytes have been uploaded to the presigned URL.

The server reads the persisted object back from storage (`HeadObject`), verifies the size and — when the backend records it — that the SHA-256 matches the checksum supplied at create time, then flips the file from `PENDING` to `CONFIRMED`.

**When to call:** right after the upload `PUT` returns `200`. It is optional but recommended — a file is otherwise confirmed lazily the first time it is fetched via `GET /api/v1/files/:id`. Idempotent: confirming an already-confirmed file returns its recorded state.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The file ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

200.description: File confirmation result

status.description: File status after confirmation

size.description: Size in bytes of the persisted object, read back from storage

checksumVerified.description: Whether the storage backend reported a SHA-256 that matched the checksum recorded at create time. False when the backend did not record one (confirmed on size alone).

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of all webhooks in your organization.

Webhooks allow you to receive real-time notifications when events occur in your workspace (e.g., document signed, contact created).

**Pagination:** Use `page` and `perPage`, or pass `nextCursor` from the previous response as `cursor`.

parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Default: 1.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 100. Default: 10.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response. Replaces `page`; keep the other parameters unchanged.

post.description:
Create a new webhook subscription for your workspace.

**Required Fields:**
- `webhookUrl` - URL that will receive POST requests when events occur
- `eventTriggers` - Array of event types to subscribe to

**Optional Fields:**
- `secret` - Signing key for this endpoint. A 32-byte key is generated when omitted
- `enabled` - Whether the webhook is active (default: true)
- `apiVersion` - API version, such as `2026-10`, that determines the payload shape this endpoint receives. Defaults to your organization's API version. The endpoint keeps this version until you change it with `PATCH /api/v1/webhooks/:id`

**Delivery:** the body is `{ id, event, createdAt, apiVersion, payload }`, with `payload` in the shape of the endpoint's `apiVersion`, which the `Sajn-Version` header repeats. `id` is the event id that `GET /api/v1/events/:id` takes, and `createdAt` is when the event happened; both stay the same across retries and replays. Every request carries `X-Sajn-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex hmac-sha256 over "<t>.<raw body>">` and `X-Sajn-Delivery`, a delivery id that stays the same across the retries of one event to one endpoint. A failed delivery (5xx, 408, 429, or a network error) is attempted up to 5 times over about 2.3 hours, so deduplicate on `id`.

**Event types:** `eventTriggers` takes values such as the following:
- Document: `DOCUMENT_CREATED`, `DOCUMENT_SENT`, `DOCUMENT_SIGNED`, `DOCUMENT_COMPLETED`, `DOCUMENT_REJECTED`, `DOCUMENT_EXPIRED`, `DOCUMENT_WITHDRAWN`, `DOCUMENT_MODIFIED`, `DOCUMENT_DELETED`, `DOCUMENT_RESTORED`, `DOCUMENT_ARCHIVED`, `DOCUMENT_UNARCHIVED`, `DOCUMENT_EXPIRATION_EXTENDED`, `DOCUMENT_ARCHIVE_UPLOADED`
- Party, each with `{ document, party }`: `DOCUMENT_PARTY_SENT`, `DOCUMENT_PARTY_DELIVERY_FAILED`, `DOCUMENT_PARTY_OPENED`, `DOCUMENT_PARTY_READ`, `DOCUMENT_PARTY_SIGNED`, `DOCUMENT_PARTY_REJECTED`, `DOCUMENT_PARTY_DELEGATED`, `DOCUMENT_PARTY_AUTH_FAILED`, `DOCUMENT_PARTY_ADDED`, `DOCUMENT_PARTY_REMOVED`, `DOCUMENT_REMINDER_AUTOMATIC`, `DOCUMENT_REMINDER_MANUAL`
- ID check: `ID_CREATED`, `ID_SENT`, `ID_OPENED`, `ID_VERIFIED`, `ID_FAILED`, `ID_CANCELED`
- Contact and template: `CONTACT_CREATED`, `CONTACT_UPDATED`, `CONTACT_DELETED`, `TEMPLATE_CREATED`, `TEMPLATE_UPDATED`, `TEMPLATE_DELETED`, `TEMPLATE_RESTORED`
- Form: `FORM_SUBMITTED`, with the same fields as `GET /api/v1/forms/:id/submissions/:submissionId`
- Security: the `SECURITY_*` events, a feed for a SIEM

**Plan Requirement:** Requires the Team plan or higher, or a sandbox organization.

patch.description:
Update webhook properties. All fields are optional - only provided fields will be updated.

To move the endpoint to a newer payload shape, set `apiVersion`. Every delivery after the change uses the new version, including retries of earlier events.

The response includes `secret` only when the update sets a new key.

**Plan Requirement:** Requires the Team plan or higher, or a sandbox organization.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The webhook ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

webhookUrl.description: URL that will receive webhook events

eventTriggers.description: List of event types to subscribe to

secret.description: Signing key for this endpoint, used for the X-Sajn-Signature header

failureNotificationEmail.description: Email address that will be notified if webhook delivery fails

apiVersion.description: API version that determines the payload shape this endpoint receives. Set it to upgrade the endpoint to a newer payload shape

200.description: Webhook response

secret.description: Signing key for this endpoint. Deliveries carry X-Sajn-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex hmac-sha256 over "<t>.<raw body>">. Returned only when you create the webhook and when an update sets a new key, so store it then.

failureNotificationEmail.description: Email address that receives a notification if webhook delivery fails

eventTriggers.description: List of event types this webhook subscribes to

apiVersion.description: API version, in YYYY-MM format, that determines the payload shape this endpoint receives

createdAt.description: Date and time when webhook was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when webhook was last updated

post.description: Approve a pending document and send it for signing. You must be the designated approver or a workspace admin. The document status changes from PENDING_APPROVAL to PENDING as it is sent.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for this document

expiresAt.description: Date and time when the document expires

status.description: Document status: DRAFT, SENDING, PENDING, COMPLETED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED, or IMPORTED

documentMeta.description: Document metadata including subject, message, signing order, etc.

subject.description: Email subject line when sending document

message.description: Custom message included in signing invitation

signingOrder.description: Signing order: PARALLEL (all signers can sign simultaneously) or SEQUENTIAL (signers must sign in order)

forceReadFullDocument.description: Whether signers must read the entire document before signing

showChatToSigners.description: Whether to show document chat to signers

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred language for the signing interface: sv (Swedish), en (English), no (Norwegian), da (Danish), or fi (Finnish)

value.description: Monetary value of the document (for contracts)

redirectUrl.description: URL to redirect signers to after signing is complete. New values must be http(s); legacy values are returned as stored.

redirectEnabled.description: Whether redirect after signing is enabled

internalRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive a copy of the sealed PDF once the document is completed

signableAfterExpired.description: Whether the document remains signable after its expiration date

sendPlainTextEmailOnly.description: Send plain text email invitations only (no HTML). null inherits the workspace default.

allowDelegation.description: Whether signers may delegate signing to another person

accessVerification.description: Document-wide verification required to open the document

aiChatEnabled.description: Whether the signer-facing AI chat is enabled. null inherits the workspace default.

nationalIdDisplayMode.description: How national identity numbers are displayed to signers: FULL, PARTIAL, or NONE. null inherits the workspace default.

sameDeviceSigning.description: Whether all parties sign in sequence on one device

documentCategoryId.description: Document category (Dokumenttyp) scoping which custom fields apply. See GET /api/v1/document-categories.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the document was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the document was last updated

completedAt.description: Date and time when all signers completed signing

post.description: Reject a pending document. A comment is required explaining the reason. Rejection is fail-fast — one rejected step rejects the whole chain — and the document status returns to DRAFT so the creator can make changes and resubmit.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

comment.description: Required comment explaining why the document was rejected

example.comment: Lönen avviker från lönepolicyn. Justera och skicka igen.

200.description: Document approval status

status.description: Overall approval status, derived from the chain: REJECTED if any step was rejected, PENDING if any step is still pending, otherwise APPROVED

autoSend.description: Whether the document is sent automatically once the chain fully approves

order.description: Stage order. Steps sharing an order approve in parallel; different orders approve in sequence.

status.description: This approver's status

resolvedAt.description: When this approver resolved their step

items.description: One approver's step in the approval chain

requestedBy.description: The user who submitted for approval

createdAt.description: When the approval was requested

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of all templates in your workspace.

Templates let you predefine document structure, fields, and default parties, then spawn documents from them via `POST /api/v1/documents` with `templateId`.

**Pagination:** Use `page` and `perPage`, or pass `nextCursor` from the previous response as `cursor`.
**Search:** Use `query` to filter by template name.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Default: 1.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 100. Default: 10.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response. Replaces `page`; keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search template names (partial match)

parameters.name: tagId
parameters.description: Filter by one or more tag IDs. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Filter by folder. Pass an empty string to include only top-level templates.

parameters.name: createdBy
parameters.description: Filter by creator user IDs. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: private
parameters.description: If `true`, returns only private templates. If `false`, returns only public ones.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

200.description: Paginated list of templates

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID this template belongs to

organizationId.description: Organization ID this template belongs to

createdById.description: User ID of the template creator

isGlobal.description: Whether this is a global template

signingOrder.description: Default signing order for documents created from this template

forceReadFullDocument.description: Whether signers must read the entire document before signing

showChatToSigners.description: Whether to show document chat to signers

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred language for the signing interface

value.description: Monetary value of the document (for contracts)

signableAfterExpired.description: Whether documents created from this template remain signable after expiration

sendPlainTextEmailOnly.description: Send plain text email invitations only (no HTML)

allowDelegation.description: Whether signers may delegate signing to another person

accessVerification.description: Document-wide verification required to open the document

internalRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive a copy of the sealed PDF once a document created from this template is completed

visibility.description: Who can see documents created from this template: EVERYONE, RESPONSIBLE, PERMISSION, or USER_SPECIFIC

selectedUserIds.description: User IDs granted access when visibility is USER_SPECIFIC

nationalIdDisplayMode.description: How national identity numbers are displayed to signers: FULL, PARTIAL, or NONE. null inherits the workspace default.

sameDeviceSigning.description: Whether all parties sign in sequence on one device

documentCategoryId.description: Document category (Dokumenttyp) applied to documents created from this template. See GET /api/v1/document-categories.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the template was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the template was last updated

total.description: Total number of templates matching the filters

hasNextPage.description: True if another page follows; false on the last page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

Sajn-Version.description: API version that served the request.

Deprecation.description: Present only when the version is deprecated: when it was deprecated, as `@<unix seconds>`.

Sunset.description: Present only when the version is deprecated: the HTTP date from which requests on this version return 400 `API_VERSION_SUNSET`.

Sajn-Request-Id.description: Identifier of the request. Error bodies repeat it as `requestId`; quote it when you contact support.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current minute.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: When the minute window resets, in Unix seconds.

post.description:
Create a new template in your workspace.

**Required Fields:**
- `name` - Template name

**Optional Fields:**
- `initialFields` - Array of fields to create with the template. Each field has `type`, `position`, and `fieldMeta`.

**Usage:** After creating a template, add default parties via `POST /api/v1/templates/:id/parties` and tags via `POST /api/v1/templates/:id/tags`. Then create documents from it using `POST /api/v1/documents` with `templateId`.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

initialFields.description: Initial fields to create with the template

fieldMeta.content: Anställningen gäller tills vidare från och med den 1 november 2026, med sex månaders provanställning.

patch.description:
Update template properties.

**Updatable Fields:**
- `name` - Template name
- `templateMeta` - Default settings for documents created from this template (signing order, preferred language, etc.)

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The template ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

accessVerification.description: Document-wide verification required to open: NONE (default), SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING, EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING, or SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING

internalRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive a copy of the sealed PDF once the document is completed (max 5). Pass an empty array to clear.

visibility.description: Who can see documents created from this template: EVERYONE, RESPONSIBLE, PERMISSION, or USER_SPECIFIC

selectedUserIds.description: User IDs granted access when visibility is USER_SPECIFIC

nationalIdDisplayMode.description: How national identity numbers are displayed to signers: FULL, PARTIAL, or NONE. null inherits the workspace default.

sameDeviceSigning.description: Whether all parties sign in sequence on one device

documentCategoryId.description: Document category (Dokumenttyp) ID. See GET /api/v1/document-categories.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID this template belongs to

organizationId.description: Organization ID this template belongs to

createdById.description: User ID of the template creator

isGlobal.description: Whether this is a global template

signingOrder.description: Default signing order for documents created from this template

forceReadFullDocument.description: Whether signers must read the entire document before signing

showChatToSigners.description: Whether to show document chat to signers

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred language for the signing interface

value.description: Monetary value of the document (for contracts)

signableAfterExpired.description: Whether documents created from this template remain signable after expiration

sendPlainTextEmailOnly.description: Send plain text email invitations only (no HTML)

allowDelegation.description: Whether signers may delegate signing to another person

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The template ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred language for the signing interface

value.description: Monetary value of the document (for contracts)

signableAfterExpired.description: Whether documents created from this template remain signable after expiration

sendPlainTextEmailOnly.description: Send plain text email invitations only (no HTML)

internalRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive a copy of the sealed PDF once a document created from this template is completed

parameters.description: The field ID.

patch.description: Changes individual boxes on a template PDF field. Same semantics as `updatePlacedFields` on documents, with `partyId` referring to a template party.
patch.summary: Add, update, or remove boxes on a template PDF field

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The template ID.

parameters.name: fieldId
parameters.description: The field ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

upsert.description: Boxes to add or replace. A box whose `id` already exists on the field replaces that box and keeps its stacking order; any other box is added on top.

pageWidth.description: Width of the page in PDF points, the unit `rect` is measured in. Omit to use the width of the PDF page.

pageHeight.description: Height of the page in PDF points. Omit to use the height of the PDF page.

pageRotation.description: Rotation of the page in degrees. Omit to use the rotation of the PDF page.

items.description: A box placed on a page of a PDF field

remove.description: Ids of boxes to remove from the field.

fieldMeta.description: The PDF field metadata after the change, including every box in `placedFields`

get.description: Returns the authenticated organization's plan, quotas, current usage, and remaining allowances for the current billing month — documents, eID signatures per scheme (`signatures`, keyed by scheme such as `SE_BANKID`), members, AI budget in öre, identity checks, and workspaces. Unlimited quotas are returned as `null`. Mirrors the limits shown in the dashboard; use it to gate features (e.g. check how many BankID signatures remain before sending) and to surface remaining-document counts.

post.description:
Add an existing organization member to this workspace, or invite a new user to the org and grant them workspace access.

If the email matches an existing org member, they are added directly. Otherwise an invitation email is sent (when `sendInvite` is true) and `invited: true` is returned.

`roleId` must reference a workspace role on the current workspace — discover available roles via GET /api/v1/workspace-roles.

**Permission required:** `MANAGE_MEMBERS` on the workspace.

get.description:
Returns the members of the workspace bound to the current API token, paginated and filterable by activity, role and free-text search. Address an individual member by their `userId`.

**Permission required:** `MANAGE_WORKSPACE_MEMBERS` on the workspace.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Default: 1.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 100. Default: 20.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response. Replaces `page`; keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by activity. A member is `ACTIVE` once they have signed in at least once.

parameters.name: roleId
parameters.description: Only return members with this workspace role

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-text search across member name and email

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Field to sort by. Default: `joinedAt`.

parameters.name: orderDirection
parameters.description: Sort direction. Default: `desc`.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

200.description: Paginated workspace members

userId.description: User ID — the stable handle for this member

role.description: Workspace role

status.description: `ACTIVE` once the member has signed in at least once

joinedAt.description: When the user was added to the workspace

items.description: Workspace member

hasNextPage.description: True if another page follows; false on the last page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

get.description:
Returns the workspace roles defined on the workspace bound to the current API token, including the permission keys each role grants and how many members hold it. Use the `id` values when calling addMember or updateMember; role `name`s are user-editable and not stable across renames.

**Permission required:** `MANAGE_WORKSPACE_ROLES` on the workspace.

id.description: Immutable role identifier — pass this to addMember

name.description: Human-readable role name. Editable by org admins.

isDefault.description: True for the role that newly-invited members get by default

items.description: A workspace permission key, e.g. "READ_DOCUMENT" or "SEND_DOCUMENT"

permissions.description: Permission keys granted by this role

documentMeta.description: Document metadata including subject, message, signing order, etc.

subject.description: Email subject line when sending document

message.description: Custom message included in signing invitation

signingOrder.description: Signing order: PARALLEL (all signers can sign simultaneously) or SEQUENTIAL (signers must sign in order)

forceReadFullDocument.description: Whether signers must read the entire document before signing

showChatToSigners.description: Whether to show document chat to signers

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred language for the signing interface: sv (Swedish), en (English), no (Norwegian), da (Danish), or fi (Finnish)

value.description: Monetary value of the document (for contracts)

redirectUrl.description: URL to redirect signers to after signing is complete. New values must be http(s); legacy values are returned as stored.

redirectEnabled.description: Whether redirect after signing is enabled

internalRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive a copy of the sealed PDF once the document is completed

signableAfterExpired.description: Whether the document remains signable after its expiration date

sendPlainTextEmailOnly.description: Send plain text email invitations only (no HTML). null inherits the workspace default.

allowDelegation.description: Whether signers may delegate signing to another person

accessVerification.description: Document-wide verification required to open the document

aiChatEnabled.description: Whether the signer-facing AI chat is enabled. null inherits the workspace default.

nationalIdDisplayMode.description: How national identity numbers are displayed to signers: FULL, PARTIAL, or NONE. null inherits the workspace default.

sameDeviceSigning.description: Whether all parties sign in sequence on one device

documentCategoryId.description: Document category (Dokumenttyp) scoping which custom fields apply. See GET /api/v1/document-categories.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the document was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the document was last updated

completedAt.description: Date and time when all signers completed signing

total.description: Total number of documents created from the template

hasNextPage.description: True if another page follows; false on the last page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

schema.description: Paginated list of documents created from a template

get.summary: List comment threads on a document

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by thread status

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

status.description: Whether the thread is open or resolved.

visibility.description: If `SHARED`, every party on the document sees the thread. If `INTERNAL`, only the workspace does.

excerpt.description: The document text the thread refers to.

createdAt.description: When the comment thread was created.

updatedAt.description: When the comment thread was last updated.

resolvedAt.description: When the thread was resolved. Null while it's open.

createdBy.description: Who wrote it. Null when the author no longer exists.

resolvedBy.description: Who wrote it. Null when the author no longer exists.

parentId.description: The ID of the message this one replies to. Null for a top-level message.

authorType.description: Whether a workspace member, the AI assistant or a party wrote the message.

mentions.description: IDs of the users the message mentions.

createdAt.description: When the message was created.

editedAt.description: When the message was last edited. Null if it never was.

deletedAt.description: When the message was deleted. Null if it wasn't.

author.description: Who wrote it. Null when the author no longer exists.

status.description: Mark thread as resolved or reopen it

visibility.description: If `SHARED`, every party on the document sees the thread. If `INTERNAL`, only the workspace does.

excerpt.description: The document text the thread refers to.

createdAt.description: When the comment thread was created.

updatedAt.description: When the comment thread was last updated.

resolvedAt.description: When the thread was resolved. Null while it's open.

createdBy.description: Who wrote it. Null when the author no longer exists.

resolvedBy.description: Who wrote it. Null when the author no longer exists.

parentId.description: The ID of the message this one replies to. Null for a top-level message.

authorType.description: Whether a workspace member, the AI assistant or a party wrote the message.

mentions.description: IDs of the users the message mentions.

createdAt.description: When the message was created.

editedAt.description: When the message was last edited. Null if it never was.

deletedAt.description: When the message was deleted. Null if it wasn't.

author.description: Who wrote it. Null when the author no longer exists.

get.description: Returns a document's chat messages (newest first), including both external messages (visible to signers) and internal messages (workspace-only). Per-signer private notes are not returned.
get.summary: List chat messages on a document

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of messages per page, from 1 to 100. Default: 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor — pass the `nextCursor` from a previous response

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

internal.description: true = internal (workspace-only); false = external (visible to signers, sends notifications)

createdAt.description: When the chat was created.

updatedAt.description: When the chat was last updated.

type.description: Whether the author is a workspace member (USER) or a document signer (SIGNER)

hasNextPage.description: True if another page follows; false on the last page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

internal.description: When true the message is internal (visible only to workspace members). When false (default) it is external — visible to the document signers and triggers their email notifications.

get.description:
Returns the signature methods you can offer a signer, with display labels — the generic methods plus every currently-available eID scheme.

This is the *pickable* set, not every accepted value. `NONE` and `MANUAL` are still accepted on `requiredSignature` but are omitted here because the app derives them rather than offering them: `NONE` is what a party gets when its role isn't a signing role, and `MANUAL` is for an imported archive document that was already signed on paper.

Build signature-method pickers from this rather than hard-coding the list: eID schemes are switched on per market over time, and sending a scheme that isn't available yet is rejected with *"This eID scheme is not yet available"*.

`SE_BANKID` is Swedish BankID. API version `2026-09` calls it `BANKID`.

post.description:
Send manual reminders to signers on a PENDING document.

If `partyIds` is omitted, a reminder is sent to every signer that has not yet signed and is eligible: the document has been sent to them, and they have an address for the channel.

**Channel:** Each reminder goes out on the party's delivery method unless you set `channel` to `EMAIL` or `SMS`. A party without an address for that channel is skipped with reason `MISSING_EMAIL` or `MISSING_PHONE`. SMS reminders are billed like SMS invites.

**Rate limiting:** Each signer can only receive one reminder per 24 hours. Signers that are rate-limited or otherwise not eligible are returned in the response with `status: SKIPPED` and a `reason`.
post.summary: Send reminders to one or more signers

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

partyIds.description: Specific party IDs to remind. Omit to remind every pending party on the document.

channel.description: Channel for the reminder. Defaults to each party's delivery method. A party without an address for the channel is skipped with reason `MISSING_EMAIL` or `MISSING_PHONE`. SMS reminders are billed like SMS invites.

reason.description: Why the reminder was skipped or failed, if applicable

get.description: Returns past delivery attempts (`WebhookCall` records) for a webhook, newest-first. Filter by `status` (SUCCESS/FAILED) or by `event` type.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The webhook ID.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Default: 1.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response. Replaces `page`; keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by delivery status

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Filter by event type, such as DOCUMENT_SIGNED. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

status.description: If `SUCCESS`, the endpoint answered with a 2xx status code.

url.description: The endpoint URL the delivery was sent to.

responseCode.description: The HTTP status code the endpoint answered with, or 0 when no response arrived.

attempt.description: The attempt number. 0 for a delivery held back while the webhook was paused.

isFinalAttempt.description: True if sajn won't retry the delivery.

replayOfId.description: The ID of the delivery this one replays. Null for an original delivery.

requestBody.description: The JSON body sent to the endpoint, in the webhook's API version.

responseBody.description: What the endpoint answered: the parsed JSON body, the text of a non-JSON body, or the network error when the request failed.

createdAt.description: When the webhook delivery was created.

hasNextPage.description: True if another page follows; false on the last page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

get.description:
Returns every event the workspace emitted in the last 30 days, newest-first, whether or not a webhook was subscribed to it. Each `payload` has the shape of your API version, the same object a webhook delivery on that version carries.

Pagination is keyset: follow `nextCursor` until it is `null`. New events arriving while you page never shift the window, so a full walk with `createdAfter` set to your last known timestamp is a complete reconcile even though webhooks are delivered at least once.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Keyset pagination cursor: pass the `nextCursor` from the previous response

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Filter by event type, such as DOCUMENT_SIGNED. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only events created at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Only events created at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

payload.description: The event's data, the same object a webhook delivery carries in `payload`. Its shape depends on `event`.

createdAt.description: When the event was created.

hasNextPage.description: True if another page follows; false on the last page.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null on the last page. Pass it as `cursor` on the next request.

Sajn-Version.description: API version that served the request.

Deprecation.description: Present only when the version is deprecated: when it was deprecated, as `@<unix seconds>`.

Sunset.description: Present only when the version is deprecated: the HTTP date from which requests on this version return 400 `API_VERSION_SUNSET`.

post.description: Queues a fresh delivery of the event. By default it goes to every webhook currently subscribed to its type; pass `webhookId` to target one endpoint, for example after an outage on a single receiver. The delivery carries a new `X-Sajn-Delivery` id, so an endpoint that deduplicates on it treats the replay as new; the event `id` in the body stays the same.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The event ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

webhookId.description: Replay to this webhook only. Omit to replay to every webhook subscribed to the event type.

endpoints.description: Number of webhooks the event was queued to

get.description:
List reusable content blocks (library entries) visible to the authenticated user.

Scope filter:
- `all` (default) — all blocks the user can see
- `private` — only the user's private blocks in this workspace
- `workspace` — blocks shared at workspace level
- `organization` — blocks shared at organization level
- `shared` — sajn-curated blocks available to everyone

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Default: 1.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-text search across name, description, and field metadata

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Returns only blocks in this category.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Locale code, such as sv or en

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Limit results to a single visibility scope, or "shared" for sajn-curated globals. "all" returns everything the user can see.

parameters.name: fieldType
parameters.description: Filter to blocks whose single field has this FieldType

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response. Replaces `page`; keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

createdAt.description: When the block was created.

updatedAt.description: When the block was last updated.

fieldMeta.description: Type-specific content, in the same shape as a document field's `fieldMeta`.

hasNextPage.description: True if another page follows; false on the last page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

info.title: sajn API
info.description:
# sajn - API v1

Welcome to the sajn API documentation. This RESTful API allows you to integrate digital document signing capabilities into your applications.

## Overview

sajn is a Swedish digital document signing platform that enables you to:
- Create and manage digital documents
- Add signers and participants to documents
- Send documents for signing via email or SMS
- Track document status and signatures
- Manage contacts and companies
- Organize documents with tags and custom fields
- Perform identity verification with sajn ID (BankID integration)

## Authentication

Every endpoint (except the health check) requires a bearer token in the Authorization header:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN
```

Two kinds of token are accepted:

- **Personal API key** (`sajn_sk_...`) — generated from your workspace developer settings. Acts as the issuing user; can reach any endpoint the user's workspace role permits.
- **OAuth 2.0 access token** — issued via the authorization-code flow (PKCE for public clients) to a connected application. Bound to one workspace and limited to the **scopes** the user granted at consent — effective access is *workspace role ∩ granted scopes*.

Each operation below lists the OAuth scope(s) it requires under its security section. The scopes are coarse and resource-oriented (e.g. `documents:read`, `documents:write`, `documents:delete`, `contacts:read`). Personal API keys are not scope-limited; OAuth tokens are.

## Rate Limiting

Limits apply per organization and scale with the plan:

| Plan | Per minute | Per day |
|---|---|---|
| Basic | 60 | 2 000 |
| Solo | 120 | 10 000 |
| Team | 600 | 100 000 |
| Enterprise | 2 000 | 2 000 000 |
| Sandbox | 60 | 2 000 |

Every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` for the minute window, and `X-RateLimit-Daily-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Daily-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Daily-Reset` for the daily quota. A `429` response includes `Retry-After` in seconds.

## Query parameters

Query parameters are plain strings, such as `?externalId=12345&archived=false`:
- Booleans are `true` or `false`.
- Dates are ISO 8601 dates (`2026-10-01`) or date-times (`2026-10-01T08:00:00Z`). A date-time without an offset is UTC.
- Filters that take several values accept a comma-separated list (`status=PENDING,COMPLETED`) or a repeated parameter (`status=PENDING&status=COMPLETED`).

An unknown query parameter returns `400`, so a misspelled filter never silently returns everything.

## Pagination

Every paginated list returns `hasNextPage` and `nextCursor`. To walk a list, pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` on the next request, keep the other parameters unchanged, and stop when `hasNextPage` is `false`.

Page-based lists also accept `page` (default 1) and `perPage` (max 100) and return `totalPages`. The documents, templates, contacts and companies lists also return `total`.

On the documents list, the cursor is keyset-based: it stays correct while documents are created and updated between requests, which page numbers don't. Use it with the `updatedAfter` filter to mirror documents into your own system.

## Idempotent requests

Send an `Idempotency-Key` header (any unique string up to 255 characters, for example a UUID) on `POST`, `PATCH` or `DELETE` requests to make retries safe. The first request runs normally and its response is stored for 24 hours, errors included. A retry with the same key and the same method, path and body returns the stored response with the header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Reusing a key with a different request returns `400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; retrying while the first request is still running returns `409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_USE` with `Retry-After`. Responses with a `429` or `5xx` status aren't stored, so the retry runs again. Keys are scoped to the workspace.

## Versioning

The API is versioned by date (`YYYY-MM`), and this reference documents version `2026-10`. To choose the version for a request, send the `Sajn-Version` header:

```
Sajn-Version: 2026-10
```

Without the header, a request uses your organization's default version. An organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request. Every response returns the version that served it in `Sajn-Version`. On a deprecated version, responses also carry `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers, and from the sunset date its requests return `400`. For details, see https://docs.sajn.se/api-reference/versioning.

## Webhooks

Each webhook endpoint has its own API version, set when you create it, that decides the payload shape. Deliveries carry it in the `Sajn-Version` header.

The delivery body is `{ id, event, createdAt, apiVersion, payload }`. Common document events:
- `DOCUMENT_CREATED` - A document is created.
- `DOCUMENT_SENT` - A document is sent for signing.
- `DOCUMENT_PARTY_OPENED` - A party opens the document.
- `DOCUMENT_PARTY_SIGNED` - A party signs the document.
- `DOCUMENT_SIGNED` - Every signer has signed, before the document is sealed.
- `DOCUMENT_COMPLETED` - The document is sealed and complete.
- `DOCUMENT_REJECTED` - A party rejects the document.

For every event type, see `POST /api/v1/webhooks`.

## Error Handling

Every error response has the same JSON shape:

```json
{
  "code": "NOT_FOUND",
  "message": "Document not found",
  "userMessage": "Dokumentet hittades inte.",
  "requestId": "req_V1StGXR8Z5jdHi6BmyT2"
}
```

- `code` is always present and comes from the closed list in the following table. Branch on it, not on the status or the message.
- `message` is meant for developers. It is usually English, but some errors still carry Swedish text. Its wording can change, so don't parse it; branch on `code`.
- `userMessage` is Swedish text that is safe to show your users. It's present only when one exists.
- `requestId` identifies the request and matches the `Sajn-Request-Id` header, which every response carries. Quote it when you contact support. On a replayed idempotent response, it identifies the original request.

A `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` lists every problem in `issues`: `[{ "path": "parties.0.email", "code": "INVALID_FORMAT", "message": "..." }]`. An issue `code` is one of `INVALID_TYPE`, `INVALID_FORMAT`, `INVALID_VALUE`, `TOO_SMALL`, `TOO_BIG` or `UNRECOGNIZED_KEY`. A `403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE` includes `requiredScopes` and `grantedScopes`.

The API returns the following codes:

| Code | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `VALIDATION_FAILED` | 400 | The request failed validation. `issues` lists every problem. |
| `INVALID_JSON` | 400 | The request body isn't valid JSON. |
| `INVALID_STATE` | 400 | The resource's current state doesn't allow the operation, such as editing a document that was already sent. |
| `EXPIRED` | 400 | The link, code or resource has expired. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` | 400 | The `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different request. |
| `INVALID_API_VERSION` | 400 | The `Sajn-Version` header names a version that doesn't exist. |
| `API_VERSION_SUNSET` | 400 | The requested version, or your organization's default, is past its sunset date. |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | The API token is missing, invalid or revoked. |
| `PERMISSION_DENIED` | 403 | The token's user lacks the workspace permission the operation requires. |
| `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE` | 403 | The OAuth token wasn't granted a scope the operation requires. See `requiredScopes` and `grantedScopes`. |
| `PLAN_REQUIRED` | 403 | The organization's plan doesn't include API access or the feature. |
| `ACCOUNT_INACTIVE` | 403 | The organization, user or membership behind the token is deactivated or suspended. |
| `ACCOUNT_SETUP_REQUIRED` | 403 | The organization must finish its setup, such as verifying an accountable person, first. |
| `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | 403 | A plan limit was reached, such as the monthly number of sent documents. |
| `APPROVAL_REQUIRED` | 403 | The operation needs an approval first, such as sending a document that requires an approver. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | The resource doesn't exist, or the token can't access it. |
| `ALREADY_EXISTS` | 409 | A resource with the same unique value, such as `externalId`, already exists. |
| `CONFLICT` | 409 | The request conflicts with the resource's current state. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_USE` | 409 | A request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still running. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds. |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | The per-minute rate limit was reached. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds. |
| `DAILY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` | 429 | The daily request quota was reached. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds. |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Something went wrong on sajn's side. Quote `requestId` when you contact support. |

## Support

For API support, documentation, or questions:
- Email: dev@sajn.se
- Documentation: https://docs.sajn.se
- Status: https://status.sajn.se

bearerAuth.description: Personal API key, e.g. `Authorization: Bearer sajn_sk_...`. Not scope-limited — acts as the issuing user.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 access token for a connected application. Limited to the scopes granted at consent.

scopes.profile:read: Read the user's profile, including name, phone number and email address.
scopes.documents:write: Create documents and edit the documents the user created.
scopes.documents:delete: Delete documents, files, folders, custom fields and comment threads.
scopes.forms:delete: Permanently delete forms and their submissions.
scopes.forms:submissions:read: Read form submissions and the respondents' contact details.
scopes.audit:read: Read document activity and event logs.
scopes.signatures:read: Read the identity the eID verified at signing, including the national identity number.
scopes.login:read: Read the result of sajn Login sessions.
scopes.actions:read: Read suggested actions and what each one does.
scopes.actions:write: Approve, dismiss and snooze suggested actions. An approval can send reminders to counterparties, terminate agreements and create follow-ups.
scopes.roles:read: Read the workspace's roles and permissions.
scopes.roles:write: Create, edit and delete workspace roles.

productTables.description: Product tables with the recipient's final selection and quantities. Populated on `DOCUMENT_PARTY_SIGNED`, `DOCUMENT_SIGNED`, and `DOCUMENT_COMPLETED`; other events can carry an empty array even when the document has product tables, so read them with `GET /api/v1/documents/:id`.

currency.description: ISO 4217; null on tables authored before currencies

selectionPartyId.description: The party who makes the selection

price.description: Unit price, in the basis the table was priced in (excl. moms unless the table prices include it)

moms.description: Moms rate in percent, falling back to the table default

discount.description: Row discount, off the row amount

optional.description: The recipient may choose whether to include this row

selected.description: Whether the row counts towards the totals. Declined rows are still listed, with false.

quantity.description: Final quantity, including a recipient-set one

lineTotal.description: price × quantity − discount, in the basis the price was entered in

rows.description: Every row, selected or not, in table order

totals.description: Computed from the selected rows only

method.description: The verification method: `SMS_OTP`, `EMAIL_OTP`, `PIN`, or an eID scheme such as `SE_BANKID`.

hintCode.description: Why the verification failed, as reported by the method, such as `invalid_code` or `too_many_attempts`.

delegate.description: The person the party delegated to.

documentId.description: ID of the document created from the attachment.

documentName.description: The document name, taken from the attachment file name.

senderEmail.description: Email address that sent the attachment to the workspace inbox.

inboxType.description: `archive` when the attachment was imported as an archived document with status `IMPORTED`, `create` when it became a `DRAFT` document.

id.description: ID of the authentication. Stable per authentication, so you can use it as an idempotency key.

sessionId.description: The login session. With the Session API, use it to read the claims.

clientId.description: ID of the sajn Login client that started the login.

mode.description: `OIDC` for an OpenID Connect login, `SESSION` for a Session API login.

method.description: The eID method the user authenticated with.

sub.description: The pairwise subject identifier, the same value the `id_token` carries.

state.description: The `state` value from the login request. Absent when the request had none.

sessionId.description: The login session. With the Session API, use it to read the claims.

clientId.description: ID of the sajn Login client that started the login.

mode.description: `OIDC` for an OpenID Connect login, `SESSION` for a Session API login.

reason.description: The terminal failure reported by the eID provider, such as `expiredTransaction` or `certificateErr`.

state.description: The `state` value from the login request. Absent when the request had none.

post.description: Fires when a document is created, including when a document is duplicated. The document is usually still a `DRAFT`. Use it to link the document to a record in your system, for example through `externalId`.

parameters.name: X-Sajn-Signature
parameters.description: Signature of the delivery, as `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256>`. To verify it, compute the HMAC-SHA256 of `<t>.<raw request body>` with the webhook secret, compare the result with `v1` in constant time, and reject a timestamp older than your tolerance. Webhooks created without a secret don't send this header.

parameters.name: X-Sajn-Delivery
parameters.description: ID of this delivery: one event to one endpoint. It stays the same across retries, and a replay gets a new one. Use it to match your logs with the delivery log in sajn.

parameters.name: X-Sajn-Environment
parameters.description: `sandbox` for a delivery from a sandbox organization, `production` for every other delivery.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: The endpoint's API version, the same value as `apiVersion` in the body.

id.description: Event ID. It's the same on every retry, replay and endpoint that receives the event, so deduplicate on it. To read the event again, pass it to `GET /api/v1/events/{id}`.

createdAt.description: When the event happened. It doesn't change across retries and replays.

apiVersion.description: The endpoint's API version, which sets the shape of `payload`.

200.description: Return any `2xx` status code within 30 seconds to acknowledge the delivery. sajn retries a `5xx`, `408` or `429` status code and a network error or timeout, up to 5 attempts. Any other status code, including a redirect, fails the delivery without a retry.

200.description: Return any `2xx` status code within 30 seconds to acknowledge the delivery. sajn retries a `5xx`, `408` or `429` status code and a network error or timeout, up to 5 attempts. Any other status code, including a redirect, fails the delivery without a retry.
